title: xDeepFM: Combining Explicit and Implicit Feature Interactions for Recommender Systems
grouping: Three sub-figures in a row with bold sub-captions (a)-(c): (a) the outer product of two embedding matrices, (b) the k-th layer compressing a 3-D tensor into feature maps, (c) the overview of the whole module. Curly braces label the dimensions (m, D, H_k) beside each matrix or slab; dashed rectangles mark the column slice being combined.
shapes_depth: Field-embedding matrices are flat white boxes holding a grid of circles (rows = fields, columns = embedding dimensions); the slice in play is filled peach-orange while the rest are light grey. The intermediate tensor is a 3-D slab drawn in oblique projection with layered sheets. In (b) olive and teal lines fan from the slab's circles up to two coloured feature-map nodes on a tilted plane. In (c) the layer outputs x^1 … x^k are tilted sheets of grey ellipses, joined by thick blue block arrows, each summed upward into a pale-yellow circle in a top bar, with a thick gold arrow out. Italic math labels throughout.
proposed_highlight: The whole figure is the proposed module; colour marks only the data slice taking part in each step (peach circles in (a) and (b), the olive and teal fan of lines to two feature maps), everything else stays grey.
lesson: Draw the field-embedding matrix as a grid of circles (m fields × D dims) and colour only the slice being combined against grey dots, so a tensor operation reads as which dots light up.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF's first page (KDD '18). figure_type module-detail: all three panels show one component (the compressed interaction network), (c) being its internal overview.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: CTR prediction with explicit feature interactions
taxonomy.note: architecture other: the Compressed Interaction Network, a stack of layers each formed by outer products with the input field embeddings and compressed into feature maps, sum-pooled per layer

core.what: the compressed interaction network is shown operating on the embedding matrix itself: (a) the outer product of x^k and x^0 columns forms a 3-D tensor Z^{k+1}, (b) that tensor is compressed by lines from its cells into feature maps of x^{k+1}

relations.form: matrices are drawn as grids of circles with the operated column highlighted orange inside a dashed frame, and the product tensor Z^{k+1} is a 3-D slab with orange circle cells
three captioned sub-figures (a), (b), (c) left to right: one interaction, one layer, the whole architecture
in (b) many thin lines from the cells of Z^{k+1} converge on one dark-green and one teal node at the top, each a feature map of x^{k+1}
in (c) the layers x^1, x^2, ..., x^k are a row of stacked-slice glyphs joined by thick blue arrows, with x^0 at the bottom sending a blue arrow up into every layer
in (c) each layer is sum-pooled upward into a yellow node row that ends in a brown output arrow

channels.colour: orange = the entries taking part in the current interaction, grey = other embedding entries; dark green vs teal = two different feature maps and their weight lines; blue = layer-to-layer and x^0 arrows; yellow = pooled outputs
channels.shape: circle grids = embedding matrices, 3-D slabs = intermediate tensors, stacked slices = layer outputs
channels.line: thin black arrows in (a), coloured thin lines for filter weights in (b), thick blue arrows for the recurrence in (c); dashed rectangles mark the operated column or feature-map slice
channels.frame: dashed frames = the slice being operated on

quality.strengths: The interaction is drawn on the actual matrix and tensor shapes with dimension braces (H_k, m, D), so the outer product and compression are visible as geometry; the three panels zoom out from one product to one layer to the network; x^0 feeding every layer is drawn as fan-in arrows.
quality.weaknesses: The panels are not tied to each other except by symbols (no matching tint or callout from (c) to (b)); the green and teal line fan in (b) is dense and crosses; the orange highlight means 'current column' in (a) but all cells in Z^{k+1}, so its meaning shifts between panels.

insights.structure: Three sub-figures in one row with bold captions (a)-(c): (a) outer product of x^k and x^0 producing the tensor Z^{k+1}, (b) the k-th layer compressing Z^{k+1} into H_{k+1} feature maps, (c) the whole CIN with layers x^1...x^k side by side and x^0 below.
insights.data: Embedding matrices are boxes holding grids of circles (rows = fields, columns = embedding dims) labelled by curly braces (m, D, H_k); the intermediate tensor Z^{k+1} is an oblique 3-D slab of stacked sheets; layer outputs in (c) are tilted sheets of grey ellipses.
insights.emphasis: Colour marks only the data taking part in the step: the active column slice is peach and boxed by a dashed rectangle while other circles are grey, and in (b) olive and teal fans of lines converge from the peach circles onto two coloured feature-map dots.
insights.flow: Panels read left to right as zoom-out from one operation to the module; inside (a) and (b) the flow goes bottom to top (matrices up to the tensor, tensor up to feature maps), in (c) thick blue block arrows go from x^0 to every layer and between layers, then sum-pooling arrows rise to a top bar of yellow circles and a gold output arrow.
insights.avoid: Panel (b)'s two fans of about two dozen thin crossing lines are cluttered, and panel (c)'s sheet labels (H_1, H_2, D, Sum pooling) are very small; the three panels also use different projections for the same tensor.

arrangement.units: three unboxed sub-figures side by side, each named by a bold sub-caption beneath it
arrangement.inputs_as: circle-grid embedding matrices (x^k, x^0) with brace-labelled dimensions
arrangement.shared: x^0 field-embedding matrix drawn in every panel; peach for active slices
